en: Looks like I must have dropped it...
I know nothing about it.
note: PLAYER (stern path); referent of 'it' inferred as the ring

en: I see... I have my reasons,
and I want it back without many people
learning that the ring even exists...
I could help you look for it.
In return, though, I'll expect a reward.
Is this the ring you meant?
No doubt about it. It's mine.
A jade ring... hm.
note: no used_in: stern player's monologue, inferred

en: Evidently it's something very precious.
"To my beloved Elizabeth"
So read the engraving inside the ring.
Give it back.
No. I'll be holding on to it for a while.
Don't worry. I'll return it to you in person.
Perhaps as soon as tonight
I've been searching ever since,
but the ring hasn't turned up
I'll tell you the truth.
So please, give me back the ring.
How did you get in here?
A promise is a promise. Here is your ring.
Hold out your hand.
Just as I thought.
This ring fits your finger perfectly...
So you had noticed after all,
that I am a woman...
Elizabeth is my real name.
First I joined the army, then the navy.
I left my homeland, England, was sent to
the East Indies, and took a great many risks.
Even so,
no, precisely because of that,
not one person ever noticed
that I was a woman.
Why pose as a man and become a soldier?
I was looking for someone.
He was a sailor.
His ship docked in England, and he and I, a town girl, fell in love.
And so, naturally, we were married.
But then he started chasing other women.
And all of a sudden, he went back to sea.
All he left me was his child and his debts.
So you became a soldier
to find your husband, is that it?
The child soon died.
I'm not the sort to just sit quietly and wait
for my dear husband to come home.
Just recently, I got word of him around here.
I came to this land as a mercenary.
And what I learned was that he had been
executed for some crime......
Honestly, I can't believe it. I don't even
know what I should do now.
But that ring, at least, I want to keep.
Because for me, living as I do now,
it is the one proof of who I really am.
The only one I have.
Now, take off that uniform.
I want to see if your story is true
Rather than weeping in the dark of night,
being my servant would make you
happier, too, wouldn't it?
For keeping that matter to yourself...
You're with the navy, aren't you?
That's right. Only as a mercenary, though.
for keeping that matter to yourself...
No, you don't look anything
like a soldier.
Well, I have no business with you.
This is the barracks.
Only soldiers are allowed in here.
Coming and going at this hour
will draw far too much attention...
Thanks for your help the other day.
I wasn't hiding, really.
Are you... looking for something?
That's none of your business.
